overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（8 篇）、公司金融（1 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（1 篇）。方法上以模型校准、调查数据为主。来源分布：arXiv（12 篇）。

papers.title: Not All LPs Are Equal: The Active-Passive Gap in Automated Market Maker Liquidity Provision
papers.abstract: Liquidity provision in automated market makers is typically analyzed at the pool level, implicitly assuming LP homogeneity. This aggregate view can hide how liquidity provision outcomes differ between LP strategies, particularly as concentrated liquidity AMM designs operating on high-performance blockchains allow liquidity to be actively repositioned around trades. We develop a markout-based framework to decompose Uniswap LP profitability into active and passive components using two complementary methods: a LIFO subtraction method that matches short-lived mint-burn positions and attributes swap-level markouts by liquidity share; and an infinitesimal LP benchmark that estimates the performance of a fully passive, always-in-range marginal LP directly from the AMM price path.   We apply these methods to Uniswap v2, v3, and v4 pools on Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Base chains, and find passive profitability can materially differ from aggregate pool profitability.In Uniswap v2, with liquidity distributed evenly and active LP behavior nearly absent, the overall and passive markouts are almost the same. In contrast, concentrated-liquidity pools have a systematic active-passive gap: passive LPs tend to underperform aggregate pool-level measures. The gap is wider on Ethereum than on L2s, consistent with active liquidity provision being more useful when block times and ordering conditions allow LPs to react to incoming flow. In general, passive LPs perform better on higher fee pools. The LIFO and infinitesimal estimates are generally consistent directionally across most pools, providing evidence of the robustness of the decomposition. The results suggest that adverse selection in AMMs is not evenly distributed among LPs, with important implications for LP strategy, fee-tier design and measurement of DEX market quality.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在自动化做市商（Automated Market Makers, AMMs）中，流动性供应的研究通常是在做市商（Liquidity Providers, LPs）的集合层面进行的，这种研究隐含地假设所有LPs具有同质性。这种整体视角可能会掩盖不同LPs策略在流动性供应结果上的差异。尤其是当在高性能区块链上运行的、具有集中流动性特征的AMM设计允许流动性在交易过程中被主动重新分配时，这种差异更加明显。我们开发了一个基于“标记分配”（markout）的框架，利用两种互补的方法将Uniswap LP的盈利能力分解为主动贡献和被动贡献：一种是LIFO（后进先出）减法方法，该方法用于匹配那些生命周期较短的“铸造-销毁”（mint-burn）交易，并根据流动性份额来分配交易层面的标记分配；另一种是“无穷小LP基准”（infiniteesimal LP benchmark）方法，该方法直接从AMM的价格路径中估算出一个完全被动、始终处于价格区间内的LP的绩效。我们将这些方法应用于以太坊（Ethereum）、Arbitrum和Base链上的Uniswap v2、v3和v4池，并发现被动LP的盈利...。

papers.title: Multiscale Reconstruction of Weighted Networks from Coarse-Grained Data
papers.abstract: Network reconstruction from partial information is usually performed at the same resolution level at which constraints are observable. This becomes problematic when only coarse-grained information is available, while the relevant process occurs at a finer scale. Here we employ the multiscale model of weighted networks introduced in a companion paper and turn it into a probabilistic framework for reconstructing weighted networks across arbitrary aggregation levels. The model is built to preserve its functional form under coarse-graining, so that global parameters calibrated on an observable aggregate layer can be transferred to finer layers without refitting. We test the method on two empirical systems with different aggregation mechanisms. In the International Trade Network, countries are aggregated into geographic macro-regions and the observed coarse-grained layer is used to infer the underlying country-level network. In the Dutch production network, sectoral flows are reconstructed across the hierarchical industrial classification, using coarser sectoral layers to infer finer ones. In both geographical and sectoral settings, we benchmark our genuinely multiscale reconstruction method against a state-of-the-art weighted reconstruction model calibrated directly at the target resolution, and therefore using additional information available at the same (finer) scale at which performance is evaluated. Remarkably, despite this informational disadvantage, our method recovers the fine-scale binary structure with high accuracy, improving precision, specificity, accuracy and maximum degree-error diagnostics, while remaining nearly equivalent in sensitivity.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】从部分信息重建网络时，通常会采用与可观测约束相同的分辨率水平。然而，当仅有粗粒度信息可用，而相关过程实际上发生在更细的尺度上时，这种方法就会出现问题。为此，我们采用了在另一篇论文中提出的加权网络多尺度模型，并将其转化为一个概率框架，用于在任意聚合层次上重建加权网络。该模型设计为在粗粒度处理过程中仍能保持其功能形式，从而可以在不重新拟合的情况下，将基于可观测聚合层校准的全局参数应用到更细的层次上。我们在两个具有不同聚合机制的实证系统中测试了该方法：在国际贸易网络中，国家被聚合成地理宏观区域，利用观测到的粗粒度层次来推断出国家层面的网络结构；在荷兰生产网络中，则通过使用更粗的部门层次来推断更细的部门流动。在地理和部门两个场景中，我们将这种真正多尺度的重建方法与一种直接在目标分辨率下进行校准的先进加权重建模型进行了对比——后者使用了在同一（更细）尺度上可获得的额外信息。值得注意的是，尽管存在信息劣势，我们的方法仍能够高精度地恢复出细尺度的二元结构，在精确度、特异性、准确性和最大度误差诊断方面都有所提升，同时在敏感性方面也几乎保持一致。。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: From Intraday Orderbook to Imbalance Price: Understanding Cross-Market Interaction
papers.abstract: Power systems with increasing variable renewable generation face greater uncertainty in scheduling and balancing. Intraday and balancing electricity markets facilitate position adjustments and real-time balancing close to delivery. As delivery approaches, continuous intraday market participants exposed to imbalance settlement adjust their positions by trading additional volumes to reduce their imbalance exposure. We conjecture that positions remaining open after intraday trading, together with demand and supply uncertainties affecting physical market participants, influence price formation in the balancing market. This cross-market interaction is, however, rarely studied. To understand this interaction, this paper uses probabilistic modeling to examine how intraday orderbook information reflects subsequent imbalance price formation in Germany and Austria. We compare orderbook representations based on open, high, low, close, and volume, Volume-Weighted Average Price (VWAP), and last mid price across multiple horizons. Each representation is evaluated using the self product, neighboring products, and the product from the neighboring country. We then compare the best orderbook setting with fundamental feature sets and their combinations, followed by an ablation study of the available training history. We show that VWAP with neighboring products provides the best performance in both countries. Combining orderbook and fundamental information reduces testing loss in Germany but increases it in Austria. Using all available observations provides the best overall performance, while excluding 2022 can reduce loss for extreme price samples. These results reveal and help explain country-dependent interactions between the intraday and balancing markets.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】随着可变可再生能源发电量的不断增加，电力系统在调度和平衡方面面临更大的不确定性。日内市场和平衡市场为市场参与者提供了调整持仓和实时平衡的机会，尤其是在电力交付临近时。当交付时间临近时，那些面临不平衡结算风险的日内市场参与者会通过交易额外电量来调整其持仓，以降低自身的不平衡风险。我们推测，日内交易结束后仍未平仓的持仓，以及影响实物市场参与者的供需不确定性，会对平衡市场中的价格形成产生影响。然而，这种跨市场互动现象却鲜有研究。为了解释这种互动机制，本文采用概率建模方法，研究了德国和奥地利的日内订单簿信息如何影响后续的不平衡价格形成。我们比较了基于未平仓量、最高价、最低价、收盘价、成交量、成交量加权平均价（VWAP）以及最后中间价的订单簿表示方法，并在多个时间尺度上对这些表示方法进行了评估。评估时考虑了自相关系数、相邻交易产品的相关性以及邻国交易产品的相关性。随后，我们将最优的订单簿表示方法与基本市场特征及其组合进行了对比，并对现有的训练数据进行了分析。研究结果表明，在两国中，结合成交量加权平均价和相邻交易产品的表示方法均取得了最佳效果；在德国，结合订单簿信息和基本市场特征能够降低测试...。

papers.title: Global Structure and Local Specifications in Sublinear Valuation
papers.abstract: This work studies the relationships among sublinear valuation rules, uncertainty structures, and local specifications in a time-homogeneous Markovian framework with killing. These objects are linked, under finiteness and locality of the upper generator and a Lyapunov condition, by three maps: robust valuation, globalization, and localization. First, we show that the corresponding classes of uncertainty structures and sublinear valuation rules are order-isomorphic via the robust valuation map. Second, our analysis clarifies how local specifications constrain sublinear valuation and uncertainty structures, as well as what information localization and globalization preserve. In particular, the compositions of localization and globalization need not recover the original objects but yield canonical extremal elements. Third, the sublinear valuation generated by a local specification is characterized by the greatest viscosity subsolution of the associated Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation. Finally, each uncertainty structure with killing admits a unique representation by a family of pairs consisting of a cumulative discounting process and an underlying state law. These results provide a framework for order relations, probabilistic and PDE-based representations, and model recovery in sublinear valuation without requiring uniqueness of the underlying martingale problems or a viscosity comparison principle.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究探讨了在具有“杀伤”（killing）机制的时齐马尔可夫框架中，次线性估值规则（sublinear valuation rules）、不确定性结构（uncertainty structures）与局部规范（local specifications）之间的关系。在生成元的有限性、局部性以及满足李雅普诺夫条件（Lyapunov condition）的前提下，这三个概念通过三个映射过程相互关联：鲁棒估值（robust valuation）、全局化（globalization）和局部化（localization）。首先，我们证明了相应的不确定性结构类与次线性估值规则类通过鲁棒估值映射具有序同构关系。其次，我们的分析阐明了局部规范如何约束次线性估值和不确定性结构，以及局部化和全局化过程能够保留哪些信息。具体而言，局部化与全局化的组合不一定能够完全恢复原始对象，但可以生成规范的极端元素。第三，由局部规范所确定的次线性估值特征体现在相关哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼方程（Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman equation）的最大粘性解（greatest viscosity solu...。

papers.title: A Generalized Langevin Model of Latent Liquidity and Concave Price Impact
papers.abstract: We model market impact as the response to submitted order flow net of counterflow from latent traders, activated when price displacements from the level that would prevail without the order exceed individual thresholds. Order flow depletes this pool, and a generalized Langevin equation governs its recovery over several time scales. Its memory kernels are finite sums of exponentials, so its Markovian lift is exact rather than an approximation. For an undepleted pool, aggregation under explicit assumptions on individual trading responses yields an intermediate square-root regime between linear small- and large-order limits, without imposing a square-root impact law. Scaling thresholds and responses with price noise makes impact in this regime proportional to volatility, and thresholds that grow with the execution horizon make it independent of duration. With constant displayed depth, expected round-trip costs are nonnegative under the log-price convention, independently of the memory. Numerical experiments show that depletion narrows the square-root range and that memory spectra producing similar single-order impacts can respond differently after substantial prior trading. Calibration to market data is left to a companion paper.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们将市场影响建模为对提交订单流的响应，这种响应源于潜在交易者的反向交易行为，当价格偏离在没有该订单情况下应有的水平且超过个体交易者的阈值时，这些交易者会被激活。订单流会消耗这些潜在交易者的储备，而一个广义朗之万方程（generalized Langevin equation）描述了储备在多个时间尺度上的恢复过程。该方程的记忆核（memory kernel）是指数函数的有限叠加，因此其马尔可夫特性（Markovian property）是精确的，而非近似结果。对于尚未被耗尽的储备池，在对个体交易行为做出明确假设的情况下进行聚合分析，可以得到一个介于线性小订单效应和大订单效应之间的中间状态，且这一状态并不依赖于平方根形式的冲击规律。通过将阈值和交易响应与价格噪声进行关联，可以使得该状态下的市场影响与市场波动性成正比；同时，随着执行时间的延长而变化的阈值使得市场影响与交易持续时间无关。在采用对数价格刻度的情况下，无论记忆效应如何，预期的往返成本都是非负的。数值实验表明，当储备被耗尽时，市场影响的平方根范围会缩小；此外，即使产生相似单阶市场影响的记忆谱，在经历大量前期交易后也可能表现出...。研究方法：模型校准、实验方法。

papers.title: Information Games: Strategic Crowding and Firm Repositioning in Language-Model Space
papers.abstract: Firms follow changing economic opportunities, but rivalry changes their response. We develop ESCAPE, a rational-share game of distribution-valued positioning with heterogeneous capability costs, establish a unique equilibrium, and derive an exact reallocation restriction separating opportunity and crowding contributions. Competition need not push firms apart: rational firms can enter increasingly crowded regions, because the full reallocation gain can be positive even when its crowding component is negative. Rivalry instead changes how differently firms respond to the same opportunity shift. In the benchmark many-firm economy, the relative-response component accounts for 90.5% of the weighted squared composition-response contrast between strategic and independent firms; it is numerically zero under identical capabilities. The contrast remains distinguishable under corpus-scale measurement. Corporate news distributions document persistent but changing peer structure: optimized peer reconstructions retain 86.5% of their aggregate validation advantage one year later even as absolute distance to both frozen reconstructions increases. Peer structure is persistent without being a fixed destination, so current similarity can remain informative without fixing firms' future relative positions.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】企业会追随不断变化的经济机会，但竞争会改变它们的应对策略。我们构建了“ESCAPE”模型——这是一个基于理性决策的分配价值定位博弈模型，其中企业具有不同的能力成本。我们在这个模型中确立了一个独特的均衡状态，并推导出了一个精确的再分配规则，用以区分机会带来的收益与竞争带来的负面影响。竞争并不一定导致企业相互排斥：理性的企业可以选择进入竞争日益激烈的地区，因为即使竞争带来的负面影响为负，整体的再分配收益仍可能为正。实际上，竞争更多地改变了企业对相同机会变化的响应方式。在基准的多企业经济环境中，相对响应因素占据了战略企业与独立企业之间差异的90.5%（以加权平方形式衡量）；当企业能力相同时，这一差异在数值上为零。即使在更大规模的样本中，这种差异依然存在且具有可区分性。企业新闻的传播情况反映了同行结构的持续性与变化性：经过优化的同行重构模型在一年后仍能保留其86.5%的总体验证优势，尽管企业与原始重构模型之间的绝对距离有所增加。同行结构具有稳定性，但并非固定不变；因此，当前的企业相似性仍然能够提供有价值的信息，而无需预先确定企业未来的相对地位。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Dyson-Schwinger Effective-Action Methods for Rough Volatility: A Correlation-Response Architecture for Calibration, Exotics and Risk
papers.abstract: We develop a non-perturbative framework for stochastic-volatility option pricing organised by the two-particle-irreducible (2PI) effective action and the Dyson-Schwinger gap equations of quantum field theory. In log-price, log-volatility or Lamperti coordinates, the joint law of the state variables is approximated by a self-consistent Gaussian whose mean and effective diffusion follow from the 2PI stationarity conditions, with the drift Jacobian given by statistical linearisation. The smile-generating exponential and CEV interactions are evaluated through the exact Gaussian moment-generating function rather than a Taylor cut. Whether the dressed inverse propagator is local in time separates Markovian models, where the gap equation collapses to a few ODEs, from rough (Volterra) models, where the full two-time propagator is retained and the characteristic function becomes a Gaussian integral over the log-variance field. Across exp-OU, SABR, rough Bergomi and rough SABR, the resulting deterministic engines match PDE or quasi-Monte-Carlo references from sub-basis-point (exp-OU) through single-digit basis points (SABR, rough Bergomi) to tens of basis points (rough SABR), with rough Heston as an exactly-transformable control. Conditional on the volatility field, forward-start smiles and continuously-monitored barriers reduce to field-only quadratures, in rough Bergomi directly on the native Volterra field, and the causal response block yields the full impulse-vega curve in one contraction at one-to-two orders of magnitude below bump-and-revalue. A technical supplement with complete derivations, extended benchmarks and secondary applications (stochastic-rate FX local volatility, quadratic Gaussian Volterra variance and the arbitrage-free FX triangle) is provided as an ancillary file.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们构建了一个非微扰框架，用于随机波动率期权的定价。该框架基于量子场论中的双粒子不可约（2PI）有效作用量以及Dyson-Schwinger间隙方程。在对数价格、对数波动率或Lamperti坐标系中，状态变量的联合分布可以用一个自洽的高斯过程来近似描述；其均值和有效扩散特性由2PI稳态条件决定，而漂移项的雅可比矩阵则通过统计线性化方法得到。用于生成微笑曲线的指数项和CEV（Constant Exponential Value）相互作用是通过精确的高斯矩生成函数来计算的，而非采用泰勒展开方法。所谓“着装逆传播子”（dressed inverse propagator）在时间上的局部性是区分马尔可夫模型（其中间隙方程可简化为几个常微分方程）与粗糙模型（Volterra模型）的关键：在粗糙模型中，需要保留完整的双时间传播过程，特征函数变为对数方差场上的高斯积分。无论模型类型是exp-OU、SABR、rough Bergomi还是rough SABR，所得到的确定性定价模型都能与基于亚基点（exp-OU）到数十个基点的PDE（偏微分方程）或准蒙特卡洛（quasi-Monte-Carlo）...。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: Debiased Inference for Bounding Wage Inequality with Many Controls
papers.abstract: We study estimation and inference for a partially identified parameter whose identified set depends on a first-stage nuisance parameter that must itself be estimated. Combining the criterion-function approach with the theory of Neyman-orthogonal moments that underlies double/debiased machine learning, we propose a two-step procedure: the point-identified nuisance is estimated by flexible machine-learning methods, and the set-identified target is recovered as a level set of a sample criterion built from orthogonal moment inequalities with cross-fitting. When the contour level is bounded, we show that the resulting set estimator converges in Hausdorff distance at the parametric rate of the infeasible criterion built on the true nuisance. We further develop a subsampling procedure that delivers asymptotically valid coverage, provided the product of the first-stage estimation errors is $o(N^{-1/2})$. We illustrate the method on bounds for the wage distribution and the interquantile range under selection into employment and on the gender wage gap with an interval-censored wage. The empirical application studies the gender wage gap using the March supplement of the 2015 Current Population Survey.
papers.summary_zh: 【行为金融】我们研究了一个部分可识别参数的估计与推断问题，该参数的可识别集合取决于一个需要首先进行估计的干扰参数。通过将准则函数方法与Neyman-正交矩理论（该理论是双重/无偏机器学习的基础）相结合，我们提出了一种两步程序：首先利用灵活的机器学习方法估计可识别的干扰参数；然后通过构建基于正交矩不等式的样本准则，并结合交叉拟合技术，来恢复不可识别参数所对应的参数集合。当轮廓水平有界时，我们证明了所得到的参数集合估计量在Hausdorff距离上的收敛速度与基于真实干扰参数构建的不可行准则的收敛速度相同。此外，我们还开发了一种子采样程序，在第一阶段估计误差的乘积满足$o(N^{-1/2})$的条件下，该程序能够提供渐近有效的覆盖范围。我们通过工资分布的界限、就业选择条件下的分位数区间以及区间截断工资数据中的性别工资差距来说明这一方法的应用。实证研究部分使用了2015年当前人口调查（Current Population Survey）的March补充数据来分析性别工资差距。。研究方法：机器学习、调查数据。

papers.title: Strategic Voting Axioms for Multiwinner Elections
papers.abstract: We create a set of 6 axioms relating to strategic voting and study them on single transferable vote (STV), Meek STV, Bloc, Chamberlin-Courant, Monroe, and k-Borda. For Chamberlin-Courant, Monroe, and k-Borda, we implement ``optimistic'' and ``pessimistic'' models for handing incomplete ballots, thus turning each of the three into two separate voting rules. We determine which voting rules satisfy each axiom. We find that under Chamberlin-Courant and k-Borda, the optimistic models encourage burying, while the pessimistic models encourage truncation strategies, indicating that the handling of partial ballots has tremendous implications for strategic voting. We define an axiom called no skipped payment that differentiates similar rules, as Meek STV and Chamberlin-Courant satisfy it, while STV and Monroe fail. Each voting rule was found to fail favorite betrayal, revealing that none of them are completely immune to strategic voting. In general, STV variants are relatively resistant to strategic voting while Monroe is susceptible to a wide range of strategies.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一套共6条与策略性投票相关的公理，并在单一可转移投票（STV）、Meek STV、Bloc、Chamberlin-Courant、Monroe和k-Borda这五种投票制度下对这些公理进行了研究。对于Chamberlin-Courant、Monroe和k-Borda三种制度，我们分别设计了“乐观”和“悲观”两种处理不完整选票的模型，从而将每种制度转化为两种不同的投票规则。我们分析了哪些投票规则满足这些公理。研究发现，在Chamberlin-Courant和k-Borda制度下，“乐观”模型会促使选民选择隐藏部分选票的策略（即“埋藏”策略），而“悲观”模型则更倾向于选民选择截断部分选票的策略（即“截断”策略），这表明选票处理方式对策略性投票行为有着重要影响。我们还定义了一个名为“禁止跳过支付”（no skipped payment）的公理，该公理能够区分一些相似的投票规则：Meek STV和Chamberlin-Courant满足这一公理，而STV和Monroe则不满足。所有投票规则都被发现存在“偏好背叛”（favorite betrayal）问题，即这些规则都无法完全抵...。

papers.title: Classification as Search Infrastructure: How Category Creation, Addition and Cleanup Shape Knowledge Retrieval
papers.abstract: Classification systems shape how searchers find relevant objects. We study how revisions to classification architecture affect retrieval by changing the routes through which objects enter consideration. We theorize that creating a cross-cutting category can reduce classificatory distance and translation costs, whereas adding routes to an established system can increase route-selection and updating costs; category cleanup can restore contrast. Empirically, we exploit the 2013 creation and 2020 revision of Y02/Y04 green-technology codes in the Cooperative Patent Classification. We match treated patents to unchanged green patents within technology-cohort cells and estimate examiner- and applicant-specific effects on first-citation timing and citation volume. Category creation is associated with a 25% higher examiner first-citation hazard. In the mature system, additions are associated with 13-15% lower examiner hazards, while cleanup is associated with a 14% higher hazard and 12% higher citation volume. Effects are generally stronger for examiners, whose search task is more tightly coupled to patent classification. Timing and volume need not move together: creation and green-domain entry shift timing without detectable changes in volume, while cleanup increases both speed and recorded reach. Classification infrastructure may therefore change when relevant objects are found even when overall recorded attention is unchanged, and greater classificatory detail need not improve search efficiency.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】分类系统影响着搜索者找到相关对象的方式。我们研究了分类架构的修改如何通过改变对象被纳入考虑的路径来影响检索效果。我们提出，创建一个跨领域的分类类别可以降低分类难度和转换成本，而在现有系统中增加新的分类路径则会增加路径选择和更新的成本；对分类类别进行清理则有助于恢复分类的清晰度。通过分析2013年和2020年对合作专利分类（Cooperative Patent Classification）中Y02/Y04绿色技术代码的修订情况，我们发现：创建新类别会导致审查员首次引用相关专利的频率增加25%；而在成熟分类系统中，新增分类路径会使这一频率降低13-15%，而清理分类类别则会使该频率增加14%，同时引用量增加12%。这些效应在审查员身上更为显著，因为他们的搜索任务与专利分类的关联更为紧密。检索的时效性和引用量并不一定同步变化：创建新类别或新增绿色技术分类路径可能会改变检索时效性，但引用量并无明显变化；而清理分类类别则会同时提高检索速度和覆盖范围。因此，即使总体上的关注度保持不变，分类系统的调整也可能发生，而且更详细的分类信息并不一定能够提升检索效率。。

papers.title: Are there asymmetries in euro area monetary policy transmission?
papers.abstract: We answer the question posed in the title with a nonlinear mixed-frequency vector autoregression, estimated with Bayesian additive regression trees. The model combines monthly macro-financial variables with quarterly bank lending survey data, and identifies the dynamic responses from high-frequency policy surprises. Sign asymmetry dominates; a tightening produces monetary policy transmission mostly in line with the theoretical predictions, whereas easing of any size produces mostly insignificant responses. Peak effects vary with initial conditions, while several common, predefined regime splits do not yield considerable differences in the propagation of the shocks.
papers.summary_zh: 【货币政策与宏观经济】我们采用非线性混合频率向量自回归模型，并结合贝叶斯加性回归树方法对问题进行了分析。该模型将月度宏观金融变量与季度银行贷款调查数据相结合，以识别高频政策冲击所带来的动态响应。研究发现，信号不对称性较为显著：紧缩性货币政策主要符合理论预测，而任何形式的宽松政策所带来的响应均较为微弱。冲击的峰值效应会随初始条件的不同而变化；此外，几种常见的、预先定义的政策分类方式并未在冲击传播效果上产生显著差异。。研究方法：向量自回归、回归分析、贝叶斯方法、调查数据。

papers.title: The Efficient Frontier from a LASSO Solver
papers.abstract: In a recent paper, Schmelzer and Hastie argue that Markowitz's Critical Line Algorithm and the LASSO path trace the same curve. Here we use that identity to compute efficient frontiers with a stock LASSO solver, \texttt{lars\_path} from \texttt{scikit-learn}. It handles long--short portfolios under a leverage cap, fixed leverage with varying risk appetite, and the classical long-only, fully invested frontier. Called naively, the last path stops at the maximum-Sharpe portfolio. One shift of the response, by an amount computed in advance, lets a single call reach the minimum-variance portfolio.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在最近的一篇论文中，Schmelzer和Hastie指出，Markowitz的临界线算法（Critical Line Algorithm）与LASSO算法所绘制的曲线实际上是相同的。本文利用这一特性，通过使用`scikit-learn`库中的`lars_path`函数来实现高效投资组合的构建。该函数能够处理受到杠杆限制的投资组合、具有不同风险偏好的固定杠杆组合，以及传统的纯多头、全额投资组合。乍看之下，LASSO算法所确定的投资组合似乎总是指向具有最高夏普比率（Sharpe Ratio）的组合；但实际上，通过预先计算出的一个调整量，只需对投资组合进行微调，就能使其转变为具有最低方差（minimum variance）的组合。。研究方法：LASSO 正则化。
